configuration: EC2-S-AW1 machinery-aft collier, Delta Shipbuilding 1945; representative armed fit

sources.title: USMC/Gibbs & Cox / St Johns River Shipbuilding — Thomas Sully plans, 1941–43
sources.pages: PDF page 2: inboard profile and holds, 312-S1-3-2, 30 August 1941; page 3: midship section, 28 August 1943; pages 4–5: stern frame/rudder
sources.supports: 441 ft 6 in LOA, molded beam 56 ft 10.25 in, molded depth 37 ft 4 in, five holds, amidship machinery, flat merchant floor and tight bilge.

sources.title: Norsk Skipsfartshistorisk Selskap Sør — Nr. 14/2024, special Liberty types
sources.supports: Reproduced postwar collier profile, wartime-gray Jagger Seam underway and primary Delta Shipbuilding launch photo dated 18 December 1944, MCE 2816 / Delta 148.
sources.limits: Profile is Karsten-Kunibert Krueger-Kopiske's postwar Mystic interpretation, not an original builder drawing. Preserve provenance; omit postwar logo. Do not use interpretation to claim exact 1945 armament.
sources.provenance: Newsletter reproduction of drawing and historical photographs. Underlying image rights not independently established; reference only.

independence: Only independently authored blueprint, versioned original recipe and original component catalog feed the model. Scans are comparison references; no third-party mesh, texture or GameModels3D asset is used.
